page.layout: One page of text in a single column, page number top right; a heading block at the top (ornament, title in capitals, subtitle in roman); then a verse title, a Latin distich, a heading RESPONSIO, a longer block of verse in italic with an enlarged initial letter, a closing signature line at the foot.

main_text.l: leges, Hispano discès subdere colla iugo.
DVra ferox Anglis quum vincla pararet Iberus,
Huic Dæmon, Aio te vincere posse Britannos
Et premere immani colla superba iugo.
Arripit has sortes, & sic exponit Iberus,
Ast Iber ambigua deceptus sorte, secures
Sic regnum Cræsi & magnam peruertit opum

page.notes: Printed page number "31" at top right. The ornament at the top and the decorative elements are not transcribed. The Latin verse uses long s and italic; the initial "D" is an enlarged letter joined to "Vra" as printed ("DVra"). Possible doubtful readings: "scitatum" (possibly "scitatum" as printed), "Ditis" and "Pyrrhum" read from the scan. Signature "I.I.B." is printed at the foot after the verse, treated as a closing paragraph.
